answer.question: How do I plan turf beside a Carolina Shores patio home or townhome?
answer.answer: Choose the area you want to use, then confirm who controls it. A lawn beside an attached home may be shared or subject to community requirements. Bring the relevant property documents and association response to the estimate.

blocks.h2: Start at the patio and work outward.
paras: For a smaller yard, a defined pet area or a compact putting green may be enough. Leave walking room between the house, seating and planting beds. On a larger lot, compare a lawn area with a separate practice green rather than treating every square foot the same.
The free visit is a chance to discuss those options and see what installation involves. Point out gates, shared paths and restrictions on where materials can be delivered or stored.

blocks.h2: Use the requirements for your own community.
paras: Carolina Shores includes several communities, and Carolina Shores Subdivision is only one of them. Use the exact community and property address when requesting documents; a nearby development’s turf policy may not apply.

Confirm ownership of the work area and any association requirements. Ask Town Planning & Zoning about the complete proposal, including grading or drainage changes. Bring the responses to the estimate so the scope can reflect the conditions that apply.

servicesNote: Choose a lawn, pet area or putting green to suit the usable space around your home.
